verzen.tekst: O death, how bitter is the memory of you to a man who is at peace in his possessions,
verzen.html: O death, how bitter is the memory of you to a man who is at peace in his possessions,

verzen.tekst: O death, your sentence is acceptable to a man who is needy and who fails in strength,
verzen.html: O death, your sentence is acceptable to a man who is needy and who fails in strength,

verzen.tekst: Don’t be afraid of the sentence of death.
verzen.html: Don’t be afraid of the sentence of death.

verzen.tekst: And why do you refuse when it is the good pleasure of the Most High?
verzen.html: And why do you refuse when it is the good pleasure of the Most High?

verzen.tekst: The children of sinners are abominable children
verzen.html: The children of sinners are abominable children

verzen.tekst: The inheritance of sinners’ children will perish
verzen.html: The inheritance of sinners’ children will perish

verzen.tekst: Children will complain of an ungodly father,
verzen.html: Children will complain of an ungodly father,

verzen.tekst: Woe to you, ungodly men,
verzen.html: Woe to you, ungodly men,

verzen.tekst: If you are born, you will be born to a curse.
verzen.html: If you are born, you will be born to a curse.

verzen.tekst: All things that are of the earth will go back to the earth;
verzen.html: All things that are of the earth will go back to the earth;

verzen.tekst: The mourning of men is about their bodies;
verzen.html: The mourning of men is about their bodies;

verzen.tekst: Have regard for your name,
verzen.html: Have regard for your name,

verzen.tekst: A good life has its number of days,
verzen.html: A good life has its number of days,

verzen.tekst: My children, follow instruction in peace.
verzen.html: My children, follow instruction in peace.

verzen.tekst: Better is a man who hides his foolishness
verzen.html: Better is a man who hides his foolishness

verzen.tekst: Therefore show respect for my words;
verzen.html: Therefore show respect for my words;

verzen.tekst: Be ashamed of sexual immorality before father and mother,
verzen.html: Be ashamed of sexual immorality before father and mother,

verzen.tekst: of an offence before a judge and ruler,
verzen.html: of an offence before a judge and ruler,

verzen.tekst: and of theft in the place where you sojourn.
verzen.html: and of theft in the place where you sojourn.

verzen.tekst: of silence before those who greet you,
verzen.html: of silence before those who greet you,

verzen.tekst: of turning away your face from a kinsman,
verzen.html: of turning away your face from a kinsman,

verzen.tekst: of meddling with his maid—and don’t come near her bed,
verzen.html: of meddling with his maid—and don’t come near her bed,

verzen.tekst: of repeating and speaking what you have heard,
verzen.html: of repeating and speaking what you have heard,

verzen.tekst: So you will be ashamed of the right things
verzen.html: So you will be ashamed of the right things
